description: Take an account or community down under the takedown policy (docs/FAIR-USE.md). Requires admin role. 'standard': hidden, the owner is emailed a private export link and the data is deleted after 30 days. 'hard' (evident illegal content): hidden, no owner export, kept 90 days then deleted. On a subject already taken down, changes the tier or deadline.

main.description: Take an account or community down under the takedown policy (docs/FAIR-USE.md). Requires admin role. 'standard': hidden, the owner is emailed a private export link and the data is deleted after 30 days. 'hard' (evident illegal content): hidden, no owner export, kept 90 days then deleted. On a subject already taken down, changes the tier or deadline.

tier.description: standard: rules broken, owner may export; hard: evident illegal content, no owner export.

reason.description: Reason shown to the owner in the takedown notice.

deleteAfter.description: Overrides the default deadline (30 days standard, 90 days hard), for example to extend a legal hold.

notify.description: Email the owner a takedown notice. Default true; false when an authority asks that the owner not be informed.

kind.description: Whether the DID is an account or a community.

deleteAfter.description: When the daily sweep deletes the data.

exportUrl.description: Standard tier only: the private export link sent to the owner.

errors.name: InvalidDeadline
errors.description: deleteAfter is not a date in the future.
